# ultrspeak

> ultrspeak is private voice dictation software for Mac and Windows: hold a keyboard shortcut, speak, and clean formatted text appears wherever your cursor is. Transcription runs entirely on-device, so dictation is private and works offline.

ultrspeak turns speech into clear, punctuated text in any app where you write — email, chat, editors, browsers. Writing modes reshape the same spoken thought into formal prose, casual messages, ready-to-send emails, or agent prompts. Every dictation is saved locally and searchable. Custom vocabulary teaches it names, jargon, and product terms.

## Facts

- Transcription runs 100% on-device with local models; no cloud processing, no audio or text upload (0 bytes sent)
- Works fully offline
- Languages: English and Mandarin Chinese, with automatic handling of mixed-language speech
- Platforms and requirements: Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or newer) with macOS 13 or later; Windows 11
- Free tier: up to 8,000 words per week, no account needed
- Pro: unlimited dictation for US$19.49 per year (about US$1.62 per month), billed annually; cancel any time; 14-day refund
- Checkout and subscription management are handled through a hosted account portal with Stripe payments
- No analytics or telemetry collected by default
